lead: Watch a whole Starship flight in about two and a half minutes: the launch, the booster splitting off, and a giant tower catching the booster as it comes home. Your settings decide whether the ship makes it to orbit, a steady loop around the Earth.
try: In Mission setup, move the Payload slider to load more cargo. Then press Apply and relaunch and watch whether the ship still reaches orbit.
points: Max-Q is the moment in the climb when the air pushes hardest on the rocket, because it is already going fast while the air is still thick.
Fuel the booster saves for its trip home is fuel that cannot push the ship upward, so the ship has less to spare.
If a few booster engines fail at liftoff, the rocket climbs with less push and separates later, but it can still reach orbit.
